CREATE TABLE "catalog_log" (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(16)))),
    "tbl" TEXT,
    "row_id" TEXT,
    "action" TEXT,
    "payload" TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
    deleted_at TEXT,
    hub_at TEXT
)

CREATE TRIGGER "catalog_log_updated_at" AFTER UPDATE ON "catalog_log" FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.updated_at = OLD.updated_at
BEGIN
    UPDATE "catalog_log" SET updated_at = (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')) WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid;
END
